commands.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
EXPECTED="4c2694dc9623873782de326cbefdf7e8b94c4bdb"
BASE="30bff5c930e9cff13b52f9bff67dc3e21ea06798"
cd "$ROOT"
git fetch origin main
echo "MAC_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "REMOTE_MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
echo "MAC_DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" origin/main
echo "CHANGED_SINCE_PRE_SPRINT"
git diff --name-status "$BASE"..origin/main
echo "PI_BEFORE_REVERT"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
echo "PI_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PI_DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SERVICE=$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)"
echo "TUNNEL=$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)"
systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --property NRestarts
BACKUP=".dev/deploy/unified-ux-20261104-09be8c4"
test -f "$BACKUP/index-before.html"
test -d "$BACKUP/dist-before"
test -f "$BACKUP/app-before.db"
test -f "frontend/dist/index.html"
echo "BACKUP_INDEX_SHA=$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | cut -d" " -f1)"
echo "ACTIVE_INDEX_SHA=$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | cut -d" " -f1)"
echo "PREVIOUS_JS_ASSET=$(grep -o "assets/public-map-[^\" ]*js" "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | head -1)"
test "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/index-before.html" | cut -d" " -f1)" = "5177a82937d38c8d2ba5b8a41156b30354f523b5c293a203d0b6ef62a5af78b5"
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | cut -d" " -f1)" = "ccc80c6f664853030e4674dfc783ec1607a9923e823b10f35b221a7348e48a1d"
curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
echo
echo "PI_RESTORE_SOURCE_VERIFIED"
'
